key_insight: A task-specific Agentic Web technology stack can improve multi-agent web task performance, efficiency, and stability while reducing verbosity and completion time.
engineering_relevance: The paper provides a baseline for choosing and integrating LLMs, protocols, and agent frameworks when building and evaluating real-world multi-agent systems.
method: Introduced MASTIF, a Multi-Agent System Testing Framework for Agentic Web evaluation.
Benchmarked 3 LLMs, 3 protocols, and 4 agent frameworks.
Evaluated the stack combinations on 300 Mind2Web benchmark tasks.
evidence_signal: Across 300 Mind2Web tasks, the abstract reports gains in task completion rate, efficiency score, and social value stability, with lower verbosity and time to complete tasks for task-specific stacks.
watch_item: Results are baseline-oriented and may not generalize across different domains, task distributions, or rapidly changing agent tooling.
paper_title: A Baseline Assessment for the Agentic Web Technology Stack
